address: 5652 Don Pedro, Poblacion, Makati - Metro Manila, 1210, The Philippines
bio: Chef Sam Rohana brings a warm taste of the Middle East to an intimate sunlit spot in a cosmopolitan neighbourhood. The compact space features colourful low tables and sofas, setting the tone for a relaxed, communal meal. Begin with rich hummus and soft house-made pita before diving into tender lamb dishes. Don't skip dessert: the muhallebi melts on the tongue. Authentic, heartfelt and crafted in a tiny kitchen, every dish here is made with genuine care.
